regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 65". Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow.

regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 45". Mt. Bachelor and Mt. Baker follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Thursday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 46". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 28". RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 31", 24" of it Saturday. Vail and Breckenridge follow.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Jay Peak is forecast for about 23". Whiteface and Mont-Sainte-Anne follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Jay Peak Friday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Jay Peak from Thursday to Friday.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Palisades is forecast for about 18", 10" of it Sunday. Sugar Bowl and Kirkwood follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Palisades Sunday and Sunday night.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 17", 9" of it Thursday. SilverStar and Sun Peaks follow.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Powder Mountain is forecast for about 12", 7" of it Saturday. Alta and Snowbird follow.

regions.title: Canadian Rockies
regions.text: Sunshine Village is forecast for about 9", 7" of it Thursday. Lake Louise and Marmot Basin follow.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
